The vast majority of Black Friday sales are already live online today. Gone are the days where you need wake up early, or camp out, to be one of the first people in line at the store the day after Thanksgiving. But what about waiting in line for free money?

Target revealed last week that it will be giving away free gift cards to the first 100 "eligible guests" at every one of its stores. The gift card amount will generally range between $25 and $100, but one person per store will win the grand $1,000 gift card prize.

How to Get a Free Target Gift Card on Black Friday

If you're looking to grab one of these gift cards for yourself and take a crack at that $1K, you're going to need to be one of the first 100 people in line at the store when it opens. Target states that its retail locations will open at 6 a.m. local time, but you'll want to check your location to make sure it's the same there.

When should you get in line?

Every Target is going to have different levels of interest in this promotion, so there is no right time to go that fits every situation. There are always going to be people who are willing to camp overnight for free things, so it's worth driving by tonight and see if its busy or not. If nobody is already waiting, you're probably fine to just get there a couple hours early.

Target states that the promotion won't start until one hour before opening and will end one hour after opening. That gives you a two hour window of eligibilty for the promotion.

How do you actually get your gift card?

According to Target's official press release, you won't immediately be handed a gift card. Upon entering the store you will be handed a ticket, which you'll then need to redeem at the "in-store event cart". It's there that your gift card value will actually be revealed.

You do need to redeem your ticket within the first hour of the store opening, however, or you'll risk forfeiting your right to receive your gift card. You can see official details at Target.com/BlackFridayGiveaway.
